item.title: Quem atende o pedido de 115 mi de t de soja da China: Brasil ou EUA?
item.description: China imports 115 million tons of soybeans while growing only 21 million, which makes it the bidder behind the soybean market. Brazil is the biggest seller, yet USDA just raised US soybean exports and cut US stocks, while hedge funds were still trimming a big bullish bet.
